01

FAQ05
How many artists can we list?

The Build includes up to 8 artist pages. Representing more than that? Additional pages start from £150 each, whether at launch or added later through Management.

Can our team update it ourselves?

Yes. The site is handed straight over to you and it's yours. If you'd rather not manage updates in-house, our optional Management plan makes them for you.

Can I use our own domain?

Yes. Your site lives on your own domain and you own it. We help you connect it at launch if it's not set up yet.

Do you write the copy?

Yes, working with you and your artists. We shape it at kickoff, written in your voice, then refine it together during the build.

How long does a build take?

A typical build ships in 7–10 days from kickoff. Larger rosters or bespoke requirements may take longer, which we'll confirm on the call.

Ready to sell more of the work?

This free 15-minute call is a chance to talk through your programme, ask questions about process and pricing, and find out whether we're the right fit to work together.
